description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeSkillDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods related to retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee skills data, utilizing setup fixtures and various filter parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeSkillDao methods within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, including instantiating EmployeeSkillDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillById
methods.description: Verifies fetching an employee skill by ID returns the correct comment and experience years.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests the deletion of specified employee skills by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Checks searching employee skills with a filter returns expected results as EmployeeSkill instances.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSkillWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with limit parameter limits the number of results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Validates saving a new EmployeeSkill object, setting properties and verifying persistence.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Assesses editing an existing EmployeeSkill and saving changes.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSkillsCount
methods.description: Checks counting total skills matching a search filter.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedSkills
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of skills allowed for a specific employee, excluding already assigned skills, and for various employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedSkillsCount
methods.description: Verifies retrieving count of allowed skills for different employees.
